title: SOCS-SH 190 Introduction to Computational Social Science · Spring 2026
description: The 12 lecture weeks of the Spring 2026 course with their R sessions and packages, taken from the course materials (lecture slides, the 13 R-session .qmd files and the Quarto site). An editable draft: chapter dates are the Spring 2026 meeting dates and move with the week shift or your term start; R-session pairings the slides do not name are marked as inferred. No assignments are included.
sources: 190 css_KIWI integration materials_09162026/Slides_26sp: module schedule tables (W1 slide 39 class outline; W3–W6 slide 2 'Data in Digital Age'; W7–W12 slide 2 'Text-as-Data'; SNA slides 2–3) with meeting dates and the R session of each week
190 css_KIWI integration materials_09162026/R Session of SOCS-SH 190 Intro. to CSS (13 R-session .qmd files, library()/pkg:: calls, _quarto.yml sections)
docs/handoff/v0.6.0-decisions.md D4 (2026-10-23 correction: pairing follows the slides' schedule tables)

units.title: Introduction to CSS
units.goal: Opportunities and challenges of computational social science; installing R and RStudio; the R environment and the tidyverse workflow.
notes: R session 1a · Hello, R! (1a. R to begin with.qmd).
R session 1b · Preview of Tidyverse (1b. Preview of Tidyverse.qmd).
Slides (Weeks 1–2): R session “Install R and RStudio; R environment; R workflow in tidyverse framework”.

units.title: Data in the digital age
units.goal: Common good and problematic characteristics of big data in the digital age; importing and wrangling data in the tidyverse.
notes: R session 2a · Import and Tidy (2a. Import and tidy.qmd).
Slides (Week 3): R session “Data import & data wrangling in Tidyverse framework”.
R Ex. 1 assigned (Feb 4).

units.title: Big data problems, contd. & research ethics
units.goal: Problematic characteristics of big data, continued; research ethics; data wrangling continued.
notes: R session 2b · Data Transformation (2b. Transform.qmd).
Slides (Week 4): R session “Data wrangling cont’d”.
Assignment 1 introduced (Feb 9); R Ex. 1 due Feb 13.
Spring Festival holiday follows (no classes).

units.title: Online data collection
units.goal: Research ethics continued; collecting online data through APIs (the YouTube API as the example).

errorHints.hint: The YouTube API sign-in cannot run in the browser. Load the provided data file instead: load("YT_scraped_Data.RData").

notes: R session 2c · Collecting YouTube Data (2c. Online data scraping.qmd).
Slides (Week 5): R session “Web data collection (e.g., YouTube API)”.
Assignment 1 due Feb 27.

tuber, vosonSML, httpuv and usethis install in the browser, but the live YouTube API steps need network access and a Google OAuth sign-in that cannot run there: in CSS Lab, use the provided data file (YT_scraped_Data.RData) instead of calling the API.
